title: 🎉 Emma Benn wins the SAGE Publications Prize
summary: Emma Benn, 3rd year dissertation student, has won the SAGE Publications Prize for Outstanding Application of Statistical Methods.
content: Congratulations to Emma Benn, 3rd year dissertation student, who has won the SAGE Publications Prize for Outstanding Application of Statistical Methods!
This award recognises the rigour and creativity Emma brought to the statistical analysis in her dissertation work. A fantastic achievement to end her time in the lab on.
